provenance.purpose: Neutral-centered diagonal motor-exploration seed for PPO bootstrap.
provenance.mechanism_envelope: Peak linkage command is 4.8 degrees at the 16-degree action scale, matching the passed visual mechanism gate.
provenance.phase_order: Front-right and rear-left move together; front-left and rear-right form the opposite diagonal pair.
provenance.foot_loop_direction: This cycle was measured moving the CAD toward negative X. It is used only to bootstrap coordinated linkage motion; forward-policy stages set its tracking weight to zero and learn direction from velocity rewards.
